entries.label: N01 B408 counts home delegation ring instead of mobile E2E ring
N01 service does not mark due work
N02 consumer clock is stale
N03 consumed promise leaves wake armed
N04 status clock is stale
N05 last outcome lost

G01 ★★★ THE ADMISSION REFUSAL IS LAUNDERED BACK INTO `queued` — a full TX queue (or a full parked ring) drops the frame at the door and the caller is told it was admitted, which is the QG blocker verbatim
G02 ★★★ THE EXPLICITLY-STORED PARK IS REPORTED AS `queued` — the pre-correction answer, which left the panel to guess the parked state from a zero handle (the inference S-37 now forbids)

G03 ★★★ A SEND THAT NEVER REACHED AN ADMISSION POINT IS REPORTED AS `queued` — the loud refusals (the joining gate, a seal failure, the type-19 structural refusals) are dressed as a successful enqueue
G04 ★★★ THE SEND-TIME RESOLVED DESTINATION IS NEVER PUBLISHED — the caller gets a handle with no address, so no `send_aired` can ever correlate and the grant screen waits for ever
B16 the expiry is mapped to a NON-TERMINAL outcome — the flight re-enters retry instead of ending
B17 the wrong-flight guard is dropped — a SUPERSEDED flight's expiry fails the LIVE flight

N01 ★★★ THE GRANT'S AIRED PUSH IS DELETED — §UI-16's panel can never leave `GRANT QUEUED`, because the generic `send_aired` it used to wait for is suppressed for a protocol-internal type and nothing replaces it. This is [[B268]] VERBATIM, and it is the defect the whole ruling exists to close

N02 ★★★ THE CORRELATION IS DROPPED — the aired push carries dst 0 instead of the flight's own, so the verdict either never promotes or promotes on a WRONG-FLIGHT match. `{dst, ctr}` is the whole reason a re-DAD inside the grant window cannot strand or misattribute the screen

N03 ★★★ THE SUPPRESSION IS DISABLED FOR EVERY TYPE — the grant takes the GENERIC `send_aired` path again, so a protocol-internal frame re-acquires a user-send outcome (§6.2(5) undone) AND its own kind is never minted

N04 ★★★ THE HELPER CALL IN THE REPROVISION DEFERRED-PURGE IS DELETED — a `join`/`leave` with a deferred grant strands the panel, and every deferred APPLICATION carrier loses its `send_failed` too ([[B268]] blocker-1)
N05 ★★ THE HELPER CALL IN THE LBT/STASH DATA GIVE-UP IS DELETED — the SIXTH site this sweep found reverts to releasing a stranded flight in total silence, grant included ([[B268]] blocker-1)

N06 ★★★ THE HELPER'S GENERIC ARM NARROWS TO THE UNTYPED DM — every APPLICATION ENVELOPE (INTRO / MOBILE_SEND / SEALED_RELAY) loses its user-send failure at EVERY one of the eleven terminal sites at once, which is §6.4 inverted

N07 ★★★ THE HELPER'S TRAIT TERM IS DROPPED — a cascade-exhausted E2E ack / hash answer pushes `send_failed` under ITS dst and ITS ctr again, into the ring the companion correlates by ctr ([[B59]]'s exact shape)

N08 ★★★ THE HELPER'S GRANT ARM IS DELETED — every one of the eleven post-admission carrier deaths stops reporting the grant at once: the §UI-16 panel is stranded on `GRANT QUEUED` whatever kills the flight

E01 ★★★★ [[B263]] IS RESTORED — the `own_origination` term is dropped from the central gate, so a TRANSIT terminal give-up again pushes a generic `send_failed` under the ORIGINAL sender's `{dst, ctr}`: a user-send completion for a send this node never made, able to collide with a real local one
E02 ★★★ THE TRANSIT AXIS IS INVERTED — only RELAYED carriers report and our own sends go silent, which is [[B263]] with the sign flipped: every real user-send failure disappears from the app

E03 ★★★ THE TWO OWNERSHIP TERMS ARE OR-ED INSTEAD OF AND-ED — `own_origination` becomes an alternative to the caller's own `generic_owed` answer, so the three deliberately-silent terminals start reporting AND the transit fence is gone
H01 B161 TEAM origin is taken directly from the static node id instead of the one stamp_origin authority
H02 B161 the shared helper restores the legacy raw body and never writes the canonical origin envelope
H03 B161 type 13 drops the H query's TEAM plane and falls back to AUTO
H04 B161 type 13 omits both name_len and the name tail from the transmitted body
H05 B161 production type 5 is accidentally rebuilt by overwriting its established body prefix
H06 B161 a type-13 hash/pubkey mismatch still installs mobile-home state and drains
